## "asset_created_by"

**Data type:**  
String  

**Value:**  
Username (both service users and human users) or null.

**Description of metadata field:**  
The name of the user who did the initial sync with ERDA. A file is considered created when it has been successfully synced with ERDA. Alone uploading a file to an asset file share is is not an action that gets persisted or has any lasting effect on an asset.

**Populated by whom and when:**  
ARS populates this field when media files are synced for the first time with ERDA.

**Updated where and when:**  
Never

**Generated by:**  
ARS

**Maps to in ARS:**  
"asset_created_by" and the event user in CREATE_ASSET event.

**Maps to in Specify:**  
None

**Notes and issues:**  
Find a way to have this persist in ARS
